data_cutoff_note: Transfermarkt historical data has no archived first-publication or receipt timestamp. Historical feature availability is reconstructed only from games dated strictly earlier than target cutoff date; no actual live receipt proof.

feature_definition.target_cutoff: feature archive fixture_date_cutoff_utc = target date minus 3 days; only Transfermarkt game dates strictly before this cutoff are included
feature_definition.verified_goalkeeper_game: completed historical game, exactly one starting-lineup position Goalkeeper for club, matching player_club_id appearance, and goalkeeper appearance minutes >=85
feature_definition.primary_goalkeeper: most frequent verified starter in prior 365 days; ties broken by most recent verified appearance, then player ID
feature_definition.training: expanding Beijing-year; each test year uses target rows from earlier calendar years only; no target lineup, result, future M8 membership or post-target Crown quote is a feature
feature_definition.direction: select side with greater model-predicted home-minus-away AH payout; one-unit diagnostic on each same candidate fixture
feature_definition.lineup_data_limit: player lineup/appearance data has no first-publication or receipt timestamp; this is historical event-time reconstruction only
